core_obligations: Reduce to K ⊕ L ∈ D^-(O_X) so L ∈ D^-; the triangle (K⊕L, K⊕L, L⊕L[1]) = (K,K,0) ⊕ (L,L,L⊕L[1]) shows, via the cone lemma, that L ⊕ L[1] is m-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 12165-12176).

Iterate: L[n] ⊕ L[n+1] is m-pseudo-coherent for all n, and since L is bounded above, L[n] is m-pseudo-coherent for large n; working backwards through the triangles (L[n], L[n] ⊕ L[n-1], L[n-1]) concludes L, and then K, is m-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 12177-12189).
proof_roadmap: Split off L with the direct-sum triangle.
Iterate the cone lemma up the shifts and work back down.
difficulty_reason: The proof splits the triangle of the direct sum, iterates the cone lemma up the shifts while L is bounded above, and works back down through the shifted triangles.
